READER_PRINCIPAL_ID: R5N1_READ_PROXY logical principal; actual roleOID/rolname bound by trusted enrollment manifest, never caller chosen
READER_LOGIN_REQUIREMENT: Dedicated LOGIN role with frozen NOSUPERUSER/NOCREATEROLE/NOCREATEDB/NOREPLICATION/NOBYPASSRLS/NOINHERIT and zero memberships; no role creation now
READER_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIREMENT: Conforming mechanism independently binds fixed server+fixed principal+proxy process+SQL session to exact context/generation; mechanism cannot amplify role authority or export any session/private authentication material
READER_SESSION_IDENTITY: Exact server generation + roleOID/name + backendPID/PostgreSQL start + retained process birth + channel/session incarnation + context + native registry revision
READER_CREDENTIAL_REFERENCE: READ_PROXY_SQL_DESCRIPTOR<SESSION,GEN,CTX> of READER_BOUND_SESSION_CAPABILITY; role is not credential
READER_AUTHENTICATION_CONTRACT: Finite role/session/endpoint binding, private custody/nontransfer, bounded onechallenge/session use, expiry/revoke/observer/replay/UNKNOWN rules in credential-class-manifest
selection_rule: DEPLOYMENT may choose concrete implementation only if every fixed acceptance property remains unchanged; new trust/privilege/secret-sharing scope requires new static approval, not silent fallback
legacy_trust: Existing legacy harness user=postgres --auth=trust is NOT selected or approved for the reader
scope_fence: Identity/authentication inputs only; do not choose reader privilege policy or compute five ACL invariants
